title: Da Lat in 4 days
summary: Four days on the plateau. December to March. Arrive on the Ho Chi Minh City to Da Lat page.

days.title: Day 1 — Xuan Huong
days.body: Xuan Huong is 45–90 minutes and free.

days.title: Day 2 — Datanla and Truc Lam
days.body: Datanla is 1 hour minimum. Truc Lam is 1–2 hours.

days.title: Day 3 — The villas
days.body: Bao Dai, Crazy House, Domaine de Marie, and Linh Phuoc.

days.title: Day 4 — The market
days.body: The market is 1 hour and free to enter.
